prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make a PRODUCTION ASSET SHEET that faithfully recreates the WALL CONSTRUCTION in the attached approved Chitin Hive concept. The reference is the visual target, especially its upper and lower room edges: broad, relatively FLAT angular overlapping shell shingles that form a low continuous rim, with small exposed honeycomb underneath. We previously got curly vortex-like piles instead; DO NOT make curled horns, circular shell piles, claws, spirals or square boulder heaps.
Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows on a landscape 3:2 transparent canvas, ideally 1536x1024. Six separate objects centered in equal square cells. All pixels inside the central 80% of each cell, transparent gutters. Genuine alpha transparency; no checkerboard, no backdrop, labels, numbers or grid lines.
Top row, left to right: THREE DIFFERENT horizontal WALL RIBBON sections. Each ribbon approximately 2.5 times wider than deep, fully horizontal. Its silhouette is a long low band of THREE large broad cracked rust-brown carapace shingles overlapping sideways like roof tiles, across one connected dark fibrous honeycomb backing. Relatively straight overlapping end joints so sections can be chained along a curved cave boundary. Top long edge is the dark solid-rock side of the wall, bottom long edge is the ragged scalloped edge facing the WALKABLE FLOOR. At the bottom edge only a few shallow angled points, NOT curled hooks. Clearly visible TOP SURFACES, orthographic camera straight overhead, not a side elevation. Resin just a few tiny dark amber seams tucked beneath shingles, no bright glowing blobs. Match the large broad planes and charcoal engraved cracks of the reference, subdued rust and umber with grey worn patches, dry texture, restrained upper-left highlight.
Bottom row left: a sparse flat low pile of broken shell flakes, pebbles and a little honeycomb grit, useful along wall bases. Bottom middle: an irregular transparent FLOOR WEAR decal of subtle charcoal fissures, compacted grey-brown dirt and a few tiny shell fragments, low contrast, no big silhouette, no circular pattern. Bottom right: a small THIN amber resin seam embedded in a piece of dark honeycomb, roughly horizontal, a warm amber accent with no halo and no circular orb.
These are for the first ant area, the Warrens. Painterly pixel illustration, same finish as the reference and its ant sprites, dark outlines on solid pieces, muted colours, readable at 100–180 world pixels. Retain natural material detail, no 3D gloss, no excessive curving, no red lava, no characters, no scene, no decorative framing.
